note: Fictional dataset. The background population is healthy by construction; each scenario below injects one specific condition so every metric movement is traceable.

scenarios.name: Maverick spend
scenarios.description: Five non-preferred suppliers are bought from without any contract reference, which is the configured definition of maverick spend.
scenarios.expects: maverick_spend > 0 and these suppliers appear in the maverick spend breakdown; savings rule SAV-02 (contract compliance) should also fire for them.

scenarios.name: Contract leakage
scenarios.description: Four suppliers that hold contracts are also bought from without a contract reference on roughly a third of their orders.
scenarios.expects: these suppliers appear in the contract_leakage breakdown with leaked_spend_base greater than zero; SAV-02 should propose bringing that spend under contract.

scenarios.name: Supplier concentration
scenarios.description: Material group MG90 (Specialised Tooling) is sourced entirely from one supplier by design.
scenarios.expects: supplier_concentration breakdown shows MG90 at a 100% top supplier share, above the configured warning threshold.

scenarios.name: Purchase price variance
scenarios.description: Six materials have orders priced 20-45% above the baseline price recorded on the same line.
scenarios.expects: price_variance_base is clearly positive, these materials appear in the purchase_price_variance breakdown, and SAV-06 proposes closing the gap.

scenarios.name: Tail spend
scenarios.description: 22 suppliers each carry only a few small, non-contracted orders, placing them outside the Pareto threshold.
scenarios.expects: tail_supplier_count is at least 20, tail_spend is greater than zero, these suppliers appear in tail_spend_suppliers, and SAV-04 proposes rationalising them.

scenarios.name: Preferred supplier price gap
scenarios.description: Four materials are supplied by a preferred supplier at the baseline price and by non-preferred suppliers 18-35% higher.
scenarios.expects: SAV-05 (move to preferred suppliers) proposes migrating these materials, with a documented price gap above the configured minimum.

scenarios.name: Supplier fragmentation
scenarios.description: Material group MG15 is deliberately spread across 31 suppliers.
scenarios.expects: SAV-03 (supplier consolidation) proposes consolidating this material group.

scenarios.name: Price dispersion
scenarios.description: Five materials are bought at prices ranging from 15% below to 40% above their usual level, with the baseline kept in line with each payment so the dispersion shows up as inconsistent pricing rather than variance against a baseline.
scenarios.expects: SAV-01 (price harmonisation) proposes moving all lines to the target percentile.
